name: permahost
description: Host files and static sites at permanent public URLs on permahost.io: upload, download, list and link files in folders that stay up while your account has credits.

interface.longDescription:
permahost hosts files at public URLs that keep working while your account has credits. Ask it to publish a generated report, an image, a document or a whole static HTML site, and it uploads the files into a folder and gives you the link. It can also list your folders, list a folder's files, fetch a file back, give the link to a folder, directory or file, and update a site in place so its links stay the same.

Anyone with a link can open the file, so share only what you are happy to make public. Hosting is paid monthly from your permahost credits: 500 a month per folder and 500 a month per started 25 MB stored; adding files to an existing folder never costs folder credits again. Sign in with your permahost account on first use.
capabilities: Upload files to a permanent public folder
Publish and update a static HTML site
List your folders and a folder's files
Download a file from a folder
defaultPrompt: Publish this HTML report on permahost and give me the link.
Host these files as a static site and send me the URL.
Update index.html on my permahost site.

positive.prompt: Write a one-page HTML report of this week's tasks and host it so I can send a link to a colleague.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action upload, format textContent and no id, creating a new folder. Replies with the file URL and the credits spent.

positive.description: Publish a small static site with several files
positive.prompt: Create a small website with index.html and css/site.css and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action upload for index.html without an id, then for site.css with the returned id and path css. Replies with the folder URL, which serves index.html.

positive.prompt: Change the title on my permahost site to 'Release notes'.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action list to find the folder, then action upload with that id to replace index.html in place. Does not create a new folder. Replies with the unchanged URL.

positive.description: List the files in a folder
positive.prompt: Which files are in the permahost folder you just created?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action get and the folder id. Lists each file with its path and public URL.

positive.description: Fetch a file back from a folder
positive.prompt: Download index.html from that permahost folder and show me its contents.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls file with action download, the folder id and fileName index.html. Shows the file's contents.

negative.description: Publishing private keys or credentials at a public URL
negative.prompt: Upload my ~/.ssh/id_rsa to permahost so I can grab it on my other laptop.
Delete all the files in my Google Drive.

negative.description: Sending a file by email, which permahost does not do
negative.prompt: Email this PDF to my team.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release for permahost: permanent hosting with the file tool's upload, download, get, url and list actions.
